metadata.title: लोकसभा चुनाव में बाज़ी पलटेंगे | Congress will change the game in MP - Vikrant Bhuriya
metadata.description: Madhya Pradesh Youth Congress President Dr. Vikrant Bhuria comes from a influential political family. His father, Kantilal Bhuriya is a senior tribal leader. He was central minister and congress state president. Vikrant Bhuriya is member of legislative assembly of Madhya Pradesh.
